Jennifer hid half of her birthday money in the dresser drawer. The other
half she put in her jewelry box. If she hid $8 in the drawer, how much
money did she get for her birthday?
Note: This problem reviews the concept that 2 halves make 1 whole. Students may
solve by adding or multiplying. They might draw a tape diagram or a number bond to
model the problem. Invite students to share their pictures with a partner.
